theorem robust_of_single_below_init [GoGlobalContext] [lctx : GoLocalContext] {e : Expr} {σ : state}
    {g : GlobalState} {threads bound : Nat} (h : Robustness.Fresh lctx σ → extsInitGlobal g →
    extsInitLocal σ g → ∀ (n : Nat) (κs : List Observation) (t2 : List Expr) (σ2 : CfgState), n <
    bound → RealNstepsBelow threads n ([e], σ, g) κs (t2, σ2) → (∀ (e2 : Expr), e2 ∈ t2 →
    RealNotStuck e2 σ2) ∧ ∀ (e2 : Expr), e2 ∈ t2 → ¬UnrecoveredPanic e2) : Robustness.Robust [] [(e,
    σ)] g threads bound

theorem sep_reassoc5.{u_1} [GoGlobalContext] (P1 P2 P3 P4 P5 : IProp GF) : P1 ∗ P2 ∗ P3 ∗ P4 ∗ P5 ⊢
    (P1 ∗ P2 ∗ P3 ∗ P4) ∗ P5

    ()) ;; body) As) (HDs : dataDirsAbsent (init (intoVal ()) ;; body) Ds) (HEnv : verifyEnvOff
    (init (intoVal ()) ;; body)) (TB n : Nat) (κs : List Observation) (t2 : List Expr) (σ2 :
    CfgState) (Hsteps : RealNstepsBelow TB n ([init (intoVal ()) ;; body], σ, g) κs (t2, σ2)) (Hprog

    progOk (prometheus.namesFree Ns) iprop(([∗list] a ∈ As, netAddrFree a) ∗ ([∗list] a ∈ As,
    httpProtoFree a) ∗ ([∗list] d ∈ Ds, dataDirFresh d) ∗ envVerifyOff ∗ extsLocalStart σ.world)
    init body φ) (hNs : Ns.Nodup := by decide +kernel) : (∀ (v : val) (t2' : List Expr), t2 = v ::
    t2' → φ v) ∧ (∀ (e2 : Expr), e2 ∈ t2 → RealNotStuck e2 σ2) ∧ ∀ (e2 : Expr), e2 ∈ t2 →

theorem walDirsFit_of_names [GoGlobalContext] (ms : List (GoString × etcdstart.MemberAddrs)) (Ds :
    List GoString) (hD : (List.map (fun m => memberDataDir m.fst) ms).Perm Ds) (hmsL : ∀ (m :
    GoString × etcdstart.MemberAddrs), m ∈ ms → List.length m.fst ≤ 200) (d : GoString) : d ∈ Ds →
    Fs.DirFits (srvWalDirOf d)

    GF) (init : val) (body : Expr) (φ : val → Prop) (hbody : toVal body = none) (σ : state) (hfs :
    Fs.FsInit (extLocal Fs.fsExt σ.world)) (Ds : List GoString) (hDs : Ds.Nodup) (hW :
    etcdWalAreasInit (extLocal Fs.fsExt σ.world) Ds) (hrb : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 62) (hF : ∀ (d :
    GoString), d ∈ Ds → Fs.DirFits (srvWalDirOf d)) (h : progOk R iprop(B ∗ [∗list] d ∈ Ds,
    memberAreasFresh d) init body φ) : progOk R iprop(B ∗ extsLocalStart σ.world) init body φ

theorem progOk_pre [GoGlobalContext] (R B B' : IProp GF) (init : val) (body : Expr) (φ : val → Prop)
    (hB : B ⊢ B') (h : progOk R B' init body φ) : progOk R B init body φ
